name: VNC Remote Desktop
description: Opens VNC servers (TigerVNC, x11vnc, macOS Screen Sharing, RealVNC with VNC password) from the devices console. This desktop connects and authenticates; the viewer only ever sees an authenticated stream.

browser.reason: Remote desktops are brokered by the desktop app (ADR-0234 Phase 2).

mobile.reason: Phones reach remote desktops through a paired desktop in a later release (ADR-0234 Phase 3).
